column1: # streams.tsv (harbor#1181) — every log, ledger and state file Harbor writes, one row each. Lane 1 records the
# estate AS IT IS; later lanes move each row onto the one envelope, store and retention rule (docs/design/telemetry.md).
# Checked by tests/checks/streams-registry-test.sh: the writer exists and its source names the needle, ids are
# unique, enums are closed. A new writer without a row is the gap lane 3's lint closes.
# FORMAT  id <TAB> path <TAB> writer <TAB> needle <TAB> shape <TAB> retention <TAB> sensitivity <TAB> on_fail <TAB> target_on_fail <TAB> lane
#   path        relative to the config dir unless it starts with ~/ or / (<host>, <id>, YYYY-MM-DD are placeholders)
#   needle      a literal the writer's source must contain, so a moved or renamed sink fails the test
#   retention   rotate-1 | archive | prune-14d | prune-15d | none | overwrite | rewrite-merge | truncate-prune | git
#   on_fail     what happens today when the write fails: open (silent) | warn | closed
#   target_on_fail  the decided policy (operator, 2026-10-09): spill everywhere except approvals and deploys -> block
#   lane        the #1181 lane that moves the row onto the one system

column5: byte copies of every source stream
